update.title: Update
update.hint: This page updates only the browser client of the PWA. It checks the service worker version, activates a waiting version and can clear the PWA cache cleanly — without host access and without losing an offline report.
update.unavailable: A service worker update is not available in this browser right now.
update.outboxBlocked: Offline reports are still open. Update actions are blocked until the outbox has been sent.

host.title: Host update
host.hint: Pulls the repository, rebuilds the stack and removes the old images. The update agent has to run for it; the stack is briefly unavailable while it works.
host.agentMissing: not reachable — the agent does not run
host.noRun: No host update has run yet.
host.confirm: Start the host update now? The stack is rebuilt, the API is briefly unavailable and the old images are removed.
host.apiUnreachable: The API is not reachable right now — the stack is being rebuilt.

errors.forbidden: The host update needs the permission system.update.
errors.update_agent_unreachable: The update agent is not reachable.
errors.update_agent_bad_response: The update agent answered something invalid.
errors.update_already_running: A host update is already running.
errors.update_rate_limited: A host update was started recently.
errors.unknown: The host update could not be started.

bma.title: BMAcloud sync
bma.hint: The object list is pulled read-only from BMAcloud. A sync overwrites name and address of externally maintained objects; notes, contact data and QR codes stay local. Objects missing from the pull are deactivated, never deleted.
bma.sessionNotice: The BMAcloud sync needs a valid sign-in.
bma.forbiddenNotice: No permission for the BMAcloud sync.
bma.noConflicts: The last sync had no conflicts.
bma.scheduleHint: Five fields: minute hour day month weekday. Without a stored value the environment BMA_SYNC_ENABLED / BMA_SYNC_CRON applies.
bma.credentialsHint: The key is only written and never returned. Without a stored value the environment BMA_API_KEY applies.
bma.credentialsSourceDb: The API key is stored in this installation.
bma.credentialsSourceEnv: The API key comes from the environment (BMA_API_KEY).
bma.credentialsSourceNone: No API key is set – the sync cannot run.

errors.session_invalid: Session expired – please sign in again.
errors.invalid_request: Invalid input – please check the cron expression.
errors.bma_not_configured: BMAcloud is not configured – no API key is set. Please enter it in the “BMAcloud API key” field.
errors.bma_bad_response: BMAcloud answered in an unexpected way.
